title: Complexity Explorer
creator: Santa Fe Institute
description: Explore emergence, networks and nonlinear dynamics through researcher-led courses. A useful bridge between economics, biology and computation.
exercise: Choose a feedback loop. Explain how the behaviour of the whole differs from the behaviour of one part.

title: Research, on the board
creator: Simons Institute for the Theory of Computing
description: Public lectures, research seminars and conversations with working theorists. Prefer a public lecture before entering a specialist workshop.
exercise: Write down the problem being solved, the assumptions, and one thing the result does not establish.

title: Build the foundations
creator: MIT OpenCourseWare
description: University course materials across science, engineering and economics. Choose a course with video lectures and follow the accompanying exercises.
exercise: Pause before a worked solution. Predict the next step, then explain why your prediction was right or wrong.
